notes.title: Update 8: Getting Ready!
notes.content:
Hey there! 😊

I’m thrilled to share the news: Update 8: Getting Ready is officially rolling out! 🎉

This update picks up the story at Day 209 and carries us all the way to Day 239, with plenty of twists, choices, and emotional moments.


🔹 What’s in this update?


💍 Ring shopping – Time to fix a big oversight by the MC and finally get that engagement ring!

👗 Wedding gown fitting – A key moment that doesn’t go quite as smoothly as planned… especially with the father-in-law around. 😏

👀 [spoiler]An intimate baby shower[/spoiler] – but in the middle of a rather precarious situation…


🔹 Content overview


✍️ Around 16,500 words (30 minutes of play per run)
🖼️ 408 new renders
🎞️ 12 new animations
🎵 21 new music tracks to set the mood
🏆 11 new achievements



Wishing you a wonderful weekend and a great evening 😊

notes.title: Update 7 Progress – Here’s What’s Coming!
notes.content:
Hey there!


The script for Update 7 is complete—coming in at 4,207 lines and around 25,000 words! 😮 I know, that’s quite a bit more than usual, but as I mentioned before, this update includes a lot of branching paths, so some sections share similar text.

The story picks up at the end of Day 141 and runs through to Day 208, with Lisa now 18 weeks pregnant! Let’s just say… she’s really starting to show. 😉


So, what can you expect in this update?


🔸 Progress in Lisa and the MC’s dad’s relationship—they’ll grow increasingly close if you make the right choices.
🔸 For those on the cuck path, the MC will start to truly see where this journey is headed… 👀
🔸 During the special event, Lisa will reconnect with an old acquaintance… and so will the MC!
🔸 And finally, our heroes will discover who the real father of Lisa’s baby is (even if you already had your suspicions 😄).



As for my current progress, I’ve completed about 30% of the renders so far—184 images and 5 animations are already done.



Have a fantastic weekend!

notes.title: Update 6 : Back in the UK!
notes.content:
Hey there! 👋

Update 6 is now live and ready to play! 🎉

As mentioned earlier, this update introduces a new character—Richard, Paul’s (MC’s) father! Lisa and Richard share a complicated past, so she might be a bit distant with him at first. It’s up to you to decide whether to help mend their relationship or keep things cold. 🤔

For the curious, here’s what’s included in this update:
🔹 Over 13,000 words
🔹 308 renders
🔹 8 animations
🔹 13 new music tracks
🔹 12 choices to shape your story
🔹 11 new achievements
🔹 Bug fixes

I also updated the Notebook to reflect Richard’s arrival. And since Lisa is now under the Circle's surveillance, she’s had a little makeover—with a fresh new hairstyle!

If you’ve unlocked every route, expect about 25 minutes of gameplay.

Have an awesome week, and enjoy the update! 😉

notes.title: Developpement Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

I've laid out the roadmap for the development of Lisa Total Investigation!

Part One is finalized. With over 7 hours of content, it’s quite substantial! I plan to revamp the beginning of the game to modify some repetitive scenes (like the Carter interview), but this will be the final change before we exit early access.

Part Two already received its first update, introducing the breeding trip!

So, what's next?

I'm currently working on the second update for Part Two. I finished the writing and coding yesterday. With roughly 15,000 words, it should take about 30 to 40 minutes to complete (if you read everything).
Now, I'm gearing up to work on the art and animations.
The release date for this second update is targeted for the end of August or early September.
In this update, you'll be able to choose from three possible events (you can repeat the same event if you have a preferred lover, of course). Choices are:


 A "dinner" with Saul;
 A shopping spree with Creed;
 A day where the MC caters to Lisa's every whim.


Planned updates?

Part Two

Update 3 will introduce two new possibilities; one with Carter and another with Jake, the captain. At the end of Update 3, depending on your choices, you will discover who will be the future father of Lisa and MC's first child!

Update 4 will focus on a competition between MC and Saul to see who can impregnate all the women on board! There will also be a side investigation into human trafficking within the circle...

Update 5 will continue from Update 4 (I'll decide if this one is necessary or if I can combine it with Update 4).

Update 6 will conclude the Marshalls Island trip. We'll fast forward to see Lisa with her big belly!
This won’t stop her from continuing the investigation with MC, Gipsy, Saul, and ... Officer George?

Update 7, the last for Part Two, will revolve around the upcoming wedding! And, of course, there will be more investigative work.

Part Three

This part won't be very long.

The first update will be the long-awaited wedding! Summing up all the choices for this will be quite complex!

The second update will explore the life of Lisa and MC after the wedding and their future! This will essentially be the final episode, depending on the multiple possible endings...

My development timeline is approximately two months per update, so if all goes as planned, everything should be complete by August 2025.

Of course, nothing is set in stone, so changes are possible during development!

I hope you enjoyed this glimpse into the future of Lisa TI!
Have a wonderful day!

notes.title: Update to 0.96c
notes.content:
Release note for the version 0.96c :

Numbers :

- A total of 520 new renders!

- About 14 500 words. More than 30min of gameplay (I think about 40 min).

- 11 animations.

Story :

- Day 49 : happens after the carter event. Classic fun if you are on the non-cuck route, more strange fun  if you are on the cuck route.

- Day 50 : A Saul night-out event with four different possibilities leading to three different mid-event H-scenes and two finals.

- Day 51 : Forniphilia in Carter's studio ...

- Day 52 :  MC finally visits Lisa's office ...

- Day 53 : Lisa investigates the Circle's Kennel ... Two paths are possible there!

Smalls adjustments :

- Adjustment to Lisa's behavior : It looks like Lisa was a badly behaved girl from day 33.
Before day 33, she doesn't make fun of the MC more than necessary anymore.
At day 33 : pa.corruption >=12 led to her humiliating the MC on occasion.
At day 34 : At the SPA, she is more sympathetic with MC and you can avoid the stranger giving a "hand" to Lisa.
At day 40 : Threshold go to >=15
After that, the Cuck path can be chosen. If you are not on it, she won't be mean to MC anymore.

- Bugs fixes.

- Renders fixes.

- Steam success is now implemented. You can have success offline and check it on the Achievements screen. There are 51 successes at the moment.

- I updated the Renpy engine to 8.2 for steam compatibility. 

- You should be able to use your existing saves (Version 0.95 and Demo).
